stories.title: Flintshire council warns of scams as landlines move to digital
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has warned residents that scammers may pose as BT as households are contacted about the end of traditional landlines. The old analogue phone network is due to close by 31 January 2027, and the council said scammers may attempt to exploit this transition period, posing as legitimate representatives to obtain personal information.

stories.title: Employers to be legally required to publish salaries in job adverts
stories.summary: Employers are to be legally required to publish salaries in job adverts under plans announced by the UK Government. stories.title: River Dee only Welsh river where nitrate has risen in 25 years, analysis finds
